about: Combat numbers. Ticks at 60 a second; distances in mm; stamina in hundredths. Starting values are the reviews' estimates (PLAN.md, Starting numbers); the feel rounds change them.

dash._about: T13: the Dash Strike, ability with heavy on the ground: 3 m forward to a thrust. Stands outside the string, like the whirl.

kick._about: T30: the ability with the launcher on the ground: a push kick off the enemy. It carries the hero back_mm from its start (a dodge, whether it lands or not), no hit lands on the hero for its first dodge_ticks, and a hit breaks the enemy's lunge or cast, guard or no guard.

air_kick._about: T30: the ability with the launcher in the air, only with someone within reach to kick off: it lands, lifts the hero hop_mm, carries them back back_mm, and gives back a jump (a lower one, hop_mm high), so kicks and jumps can chain; it breaks a lunge or cast as the ground kick does.

dive._about: T39: the ability with jump in the air: a kick diving down a line at the locked target (else ahead, at least dive_deg below level) at dive_mm_s after a short wind-up. A body it strikes in the air is driven into the ground; the hero springs hop_mm off it, and an air kick off that body gives back the Updraft. The flight may be cut from tick 8 (its cancel), so the air kick can follow.

parry._about: T31: LT / L2 / F: the tool snapped up across the body. From tick 1 to 16 a blow that reaches the hero is turned aside (see parry below); missed, it plays out to its cancel tick (28) before the next move. On the ground only; it stands outside the string.

riposte._about: T31: after a parry lands: the blow knocked aside; the next move may start from tick 6.

air_lift._about: T13: the Updraft, ability with heavy in the air, once an airtime: on an airborne enemy it lifts both bodies 1.8 m and the air string starts over.

spin_slash._about: T18: the first string's fourth press: a full turn into a backhand cut. Damage and stagger as light_3, which it replaces; a wider arc and a bigger shake.

crescent._about: T18: the first string's last press: a rising crescent from the left hip over the head. Damage and stagger as heavy_2, which it replaces; a wider arc and a bigger shake.

skybreaker._about: T18: the launched first string's launcher: a two-handed uppercut with a hop. Damage and stagger as the launcher, which it replaces; a wider arc and a bigger shake.

hook._about: T18: Pick and Axe's third press: a low hooking pull of the pick. Damage and stagger as heavy_1, which it replaces; a wider arc.

cleave._about: T13: the Pick and Axe finisher.

combo._glow: T18: a finished named string lights the hero for glow ticks in glow_rgb, and its name shows at the top of the screen for banner ticks

_combos: T18: finishers name the moves the last two presses of a named string play instead of their usual ones (the second to last, then the last).

combos.name: pick_and_axe
combos._about: T13: the second heavy of light, light, heavy, heavy is the Cleave, a two-handed chop with stagger 4: on its own it breaks most of a guard. T18: the first heavy is the Hook.

parry._about: T31: a parry that lands puts strain on the attacker's guard (a body with no guard is stunned outright) and ends its lunge; both stop (hitstop, enemy_hitstop); a guard that holds staggers back hold ticks and rests rest ticks before it leaps again; the hero flashes rgb for flash ticks and ripostes. The beast catches a launcher: the hero reels as from a heavy blow, and the beast holds its catch catch_hold ticks, then may strike at once.

grab._about: T19: grabs and throws. L1 / LB or Q tapped on its own (T31: LT / L2 is now the parry) (released within tap_ticks, no attack while it was down), takes a stunned or downed body within reach_mm; it is held hold_mm before the hero and hold_up_mm up for at most hold_ticks. Light throws it the way the stick points (toss: toss_mm_s forward, rising toss_rise_mm), heavy slams it down at slam_drop_mm_s, the launcher tosses it up_rise_mm straight up; each deals its damage on landing. T21: in the air the hero grabs a stunned or airborne body within reach_mm across and air_reach_up_mm in height, and hangs holding it for at most air_hold_ticks. The toss up is refused while the body's relaunch timer runs (stun.relaunch, set by a launch or a toss up). A thrown body that reaches another deals impact_damage to both and impact_strain toward the struck one's guard.

hurt._about: T25: the hero's reactions to a hit. Each enemy's attack has a weight (its `hit`: light, heavy or down; light when unnamed; any hit in the air is down). The hit stops what the hero was doing, pushes them back push_mm over push_ticks and stuns them stun ticks while the weight's clip plays; while down no hit lands. A hit during a stagger, or within grace ticks after it, hurts but does not stagger again, so a pack cannot keep the hero reeling. A move with `armor` (super armor) plays on through a hit: the hero still takes the damage, stops armor_hitstop ticks and flashes armor_rgb for armor_flash ticks.

air._about: T6: air combos. An air move that lands on an airborne enemy opens the next air move in the string and holds both bodies up; the launcher in the air is the slam, a dive at slam_mm_s that drives a hit enemy into the ground, down for slam_landed ticks.

warden._about: T30: the boss, a faster, smarter stalker fought one on one: half as big again in menace, 1.7 times a dog's pace and leap, resting less than half as long between leaps, guard 7 clearing after 45 ticks; its tree reads the hero's swing and often steps out of it.

beast._about: T31: a hunched four-armed beast that strikes twice in a leap, the upper claws then the lower. Guard 6, clearing after 70 ticks. It catches any launcher on the ground (parries_launcher): only a throw, a grab and then the launcher's toss up, puts it in the air.

sparring_beast._about: T31: a beast for the drills: it strikes softly (3), never falls, and its guard's strain holds 300 ticks, so two parries break it.

alpha_dog._about: T32: a pack leader: a dog a third bigger in gold and black, quicker (130%) and resting less (70%), poise 2 so a single light hit does not stun it.

storm_caster._about: T32: a caster in ice blue whose bolts are faster (14 m/s) and come every 60 ticks after the cast, each a little weaker (7); it runs faster when the hero comes near.

iron_brute._about: T32: a brute in dark iron with white seams: guard 10, clearing after 90 ticks, so it takes a long string with a Dash Strike or Cleave, parries or a thrown body to break; it moves at 80%.

beast_whelp._about: T32: a young beast, smaller (85%) and quicker (130%), guard 4; it still catches a launcher.

elder_beast._about: T32: an old beast, bigger (135%) and slower to tire, bone-pale with blue edges: health 820, guard 8 clearing after 90 ticks, two slashes of 14; it catches a launcher.

keeper._about: T33: the boss of World 2: a robed keeper on the beast's skeleton. Its attack is a chain of five strikes; parrying all five in a row breaks it open (stunned); a strike that lands starts the count again. It holds three stances in turn, 7 s each, each with its mark: glowing dots reflect the launcher, purple smoke reflects light attacks, red embers reflect heavy attacks. A reflected move does not land; the hero reels and takes 8. Guard 14, clearing after 40 ticks, so strings alone seldom break it.

dummy._about: T28: the drills' partner: a dog that never attacks and never falls (health 100000), stunned by any hit, so every move can be practised on it.

sparring_dog._about: T28: a dog for the drills that leaps at the hero (bite 3) and never falls, for the Whirlwind Strike and super armor.

dummy_brute._about: T28: a brute for the drills that never attacks and never falls, its guard 6 as a brute's, for breaking a guard.

brute._about: T10: a block on a skid with two block fists. It slides in and hammers both fists down. Guard 6: a hit adds its move's stagger (light 1, heavy 2), and only a string that reaches 6 without a 70-tick gap breaks the guard and stuns it; until then hits shake it and its swing goes on.

stalker._about: T11: a tall thin biped with a blade for a right arm. It dashes in and slashes across. Guard 5, clearing after 60 ticks without a hit.

heavy_brute._about: T15: a bigger brute in rust plate with blue seams. Guard 8, clearing after 80 ticks: a full five-hit string is not enough on its own; a Dash Strike or Cleave in the string breaks it.

scout._about: T15: a smaller, quicker stalker in teal with a gold edge. Guard 3, clearing after 50 ticks; it reacts faster and hits lighter.

caster._about: T7: a slim violet dog that keeps its distance and spits bolts. Poise 0: every hit staggers it and breaks its cast. It takes no attack token; its bolts are paced by cast.gap.

_round3: Round 3 (the animator, the newcomer): every hit shakes the target, sized by the move.
_round4: Round 4 (the animator, the veteran): every hit bends the target's spine, neck and hips over whatever clip plays, held through hit-stop, then fading over flinch_fade ticks.
_camera_follow: T1: lock-on turns the camera toward the target only after this many ticks without mouse or right-stick input.
